ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: there are four schematic diagrams of the Australian continent in the figure, and Figure Ding on the right draws the 14°C isotherm; this isotherm shows a local bend in the eastern part of the continent near the location marked N. Then reason: N corresponds to the eastern mountains of Australia, namely the area of the Great Dividing Range. Higher terrain causes temperature to decrease, and when an isotherm passes through mountains, it bends because of changes in elevation. Therefore, the main reason for the bending of the 14°C isotherm at N in Figure Ding is the influence of topography.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the schematic diagram of a certain continent and answer the following questions.

<image1>

What is the reason for the bending of the 14°C isotherm at N in Figure Ding?

method.method_draft: 先观察丁图，确定问题所指的是14°C等温线在澳大利亚东部N处的局部弯曲。再结合该位置对应澳大利亚东部山地/大分水岭，运用“海拔越高气温越低，地形会使等温线发生弯曲”的规律，得出该弯曲主要是受地形影响。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有四幅澳大利亚大陆示意图，右侧的丁图画出了14°C等温线；该等温线在大陆东部靠近标注N的位置出现局部弯曲。再推理：N处对应澳大利亚东部山地，即大分水岭一带。地势较高会使气温降低，等温线经过山地时会因海拔变化而发生弯曲。因此，丁图中14°C等温线在N处弯曲的主要原因是地形影响。
